title: PDF.js source edit contract
scope: Source-backed text edits made in /documents/{id}/edit-new?pdfjs=1 and exported through the PDF.js visible download path.

sourceOfTruth.savedAnnotation: The saved annotation record is authoritative for replacement text and edit state.
sourceOfTruth.sourceGeometry: pdfjsSourceX, pdfjsSourceY, pdfjsSourceW, and pdfjsSourceH are the immutable source rectangle used for masking/redaction.
sourceOfTruth.movedMaskGeometry: For movedTextOverlay source masks, pdfjsSourceX/Y/W/H or sourceBboxX/Y/W/H are the exact immutable saved mask dimensions. DOM geometry, page offsets, visual annotation box dimensions, inflation, or padding must never alter the persisted/browser mask box. During PDF export only, the visual whiteout may be unioned with the matching original PDF glyph bbox for the same source text when the saved PDF.js line box under-covers the actual PDF ink; it must never expand from the moved/current annotation box or unrelated neighboring text.
sourceOfTruth.sourceText: pdfjsSourceText, falling back to originalText, is the immutable original PDF text for comparison and redaction lookup.

preChangeChecks: Before changing PDF.js source mask, moved overlay, sourceSpanRuns, annotation drag, or source bbox persistence code, verify this contract file and preserve movedMaskGeometry unchanged.

For movedTextOverlay source masks, test at least one actual browser move and assert mask left/top/width/height match the bbox-derived values from sourceBboxX/Y/W/H or pdfjsSourceX/Y/W/H within 0.25px.

Do not accept a change that fixes visual placement by adding DOM page offsets, using getBoundingClientRect height as source height, inflating the moved mask, or persisting visual annotation box dimensions as source mask dimensions.

For saved PDF.js moved-source overlays whose PDF.js bbox under-covers the original glyph ink, export must prove it covers only the matching source text glyph bbox near the immutable source box and must run node tests/OverlayEditor/run_pdfjs_moved_source_title_regression.cjs.

steps.title: Changed source text is a replacement, not a paint-over
steps.rule: When a source-backed PDF.js text annotation is changed, moved, or deleted, export must remove/redact the original source text before drawing any replacement text or visual background mask.

implementation.behavior: The exporter redacts matching source text rects first, then paints the sampled source mask fill, then stamps replacement text.

steps.title: Replacement text comes only from saved annotation text
steps.rule: The export path must draw the saved annotation text as the replacement and must not recover replacement text from the PDF.js text layer or extraction source.

implementation.behavior: The exporter resolves PDF.js source replacement ink from the saved annotation text field only. Missing text stays empty, deleted source edits draw no replacement, and pdfjsSourceText/originalText are never used as replacement fallback.

steps.title: Edit mode only owns unchanged source boxes
steps.rule: While Edit PDF is on, unchanged source-backed saved overlays may be matched into source edit boxes instead of pre-rendered as persisted overlay boxes. Changed replacement text, style-dirty overlays, rich/manual overlays, moved overlays, and deleted overlays must remain visible through the persisted overlay path.
requiredInputs: pdfjsSourceX or pdfjsSourceY or pdfjsAnchorUid or pdfjsSourceText
text equals pdfjsSourceText or originalText after whitespace normalization

implementation.behavior: renderAnnotationBoxLayer filters only unchanged source-backed saved overlays out of the pre-rendered persisted overlay pass while edit mode is on, so findPersistedAnnotationForSpan can attach no-op saved annotations to source edit boxes without hiding real replacement text.

steps.title: Browser and export use the same source metrics
steps.rule: Download export must use the same source rectangle, source font metadata, transform scale, and replacement text semantics that the browser uses for the source edit.

implementation.behavior: The exporter resolves a single metrics snapshot from the saved annotation payload. Source masking uses the saved pdfjsSource rectangle, replacement ink uses saved text semantics, and layout scaling uses the saved PDF.js source transform scale unless the annotation has been promoted to rich/manual mode.

steps.title: Edited promoted rows remain visible in edit mode
steps.rule: Promoted-from-extraction rows that have changed text, rich/manual styling, movement, reflow, or dirty/user-authored state must render as persisted overlays while Edit PDF is on. Clean unchanged promoted rows may still use the lightweight fallback/source text path to avoid duplicating original PDF text. Exception: a clean, unchanged multi-line promoted block whose only rich signal is pdfjsEditorMode='rich' (forced by its newlines) stays paragraph-grouped; pdfjsEditorMode='rich' only forces a persisted overlay for single-line promoted rows.
requiredInputs: text differs from pdfjsSourceText or originalText, or dirty/user-authored/rich/manual/reflow state is truthy

implementation.behavior: renderAnnotationBoxLayer includes edited promoted text in the pre-rendered persisted overlay pass and excludes those same rows from the clean promoted fallback pass. pageNeedsOverlayProtection also treats edited promoted rows as protected overlays.

steps.title: Changed source rows need end-to-end tests
steps.rule: A changed source row must be covered from saved annotation payload through exported PDF text search/render checks.

steps.title: Moved source masks keep exact PDF.js bboxes
steps.rule: When movedTextOverlay is true, the original-source mask must use the exact saved PDF.js/source bbox rectangle. The mask left, top, width, and height are derived only from pdfjsSourceX/Y/W/H or sourceBboxX/Y/W/H and the current PDF.js scale. They must not be changed by DOM offsets, visual annotation box dimensions, getBoundingClientRect-derived heights, inflation, padding, or rule-aware expansion.
requiredInputs: sourceSpanRuns only for horizontal splits inside the exact bbox

verification.assertion: After moving the annotation, the source mask style left/top/width/height must match bbox-derived values within 0.25px, and sourceMaskX/Y/W/H must remain equal to the source bbox values.

implementation.behavior: Moved masks use the exact source bbox for their container and only use sourceSpanRuns to split horizontally inside that bbox; no DOM coordinate offsets or visual box heights are allowed.

steps.title: Single-span promoted title edits use exact line fitting
steps.rule: Dirty promoted annotations with exactly one source text span must not use the multi-style dirty-promoted span mapper. They must render through the exact source-line path so replacement text is fitted back into the original source title bbox instead of collapsing, shifting, or overflowing after save/export.
requiredInputs: sourceSpans contains exactly one non-empty text span
sourceLineBBoxes contains the original title/source line box
replacement text differs from originalText/source text

verification.assertion: The exported replacement is found in the title band and its rendered width remains within 0.75pt of the original source title width.

implementation.behavior: Single-span dirty promoted edits return no multi-span layout, allowing normalize_exact_source_line_layout and draw_text_using_exact_source_lines to fit the replacement into the source bbox.

steps.title: Moved PDF.js title overlays cover source glyph ink
steps.rule: Saved PDF.js source overlays such as pdfjs_4170_0_0:0 must export like the frontend: the original source title ink is fully visually covered, and the replacement uses source-derived heavy title styling instead of thin generic text. If the saved PDF.js line box is shorter than the original PDF glyph bbox, export may union the immutable source mask with only the matching original source-text glyph bbox near that source box.
requiredInputs: source text exists in the original PDF near the immutable source box

verification.assertion: The exported title crop has no visible old left-edge SS-4 ink and the SS-5 replacement dark-pixel density remains title-weight rather than thin regular text.

implementation.behavior: The exporter keeps the saved/browser source mask box immutable, recovers the actual matching original PDF source glyph bbox only for visual ink coverage, and infers heavy source title weights from PDF font names such as HelveticaNeueLTStd-BlkCn.
